scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:device: npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination id=$IOS_DEVICE -derivedDataPath ios/App/build -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=$IOS_TEAM CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic -quiet build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device $IOS_DEVICE ios/App/build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device $IOS_DEVICE com.ashhun.jarvis
